# T15 synthetic geometry ledger

Every numerical fixture value is synthetic, not real aircraft data. Section slope explicitly calls the cited theoretical 2*pi helper. Zero coordinates/angles and all mesh/tolerance settings are ledgered separately in vlm_test_values.md.

| `one_panel.span_m` | `4.0` | SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE, not real wing geometry. |
| `one_panel.chord_m` | `2.0` | SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE, not real wing geometry. |
| `rectangular.span_m` | `8.0` | SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE, not real wing geometry. |
| `rectangular.chord_m` | `1.0` | SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE, not real wing geometry. |
| `high_ar.span_m` | `40.0` | SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE, not real wing geometry. |
